model: Choose nonnegative active masses m_a,m_c whose sum is assembled mass minus inactive mass. The only lithium source is the initial cathode inventory. Anode formation efficiency eta means reversible returned charge Q_rev=eta*Q_extracted;its irreversible loss consumes cathode lithium. Thus the first discharge must satisfy Q_rev<=C_a*m_a and Q_rev/eta<=C_c*m_c. The stated anode C_a is reversible capacity per gram active,not first-charge input capacity. No prelithiation,extra lithium,voltage variation or further cycling loss is included.
target: Maximize first-discharge energy for the fixed1g assembled model. Return optimal anode and cathode active masses,first reversible discharge charge,irreversible lithium-loss charge at this optimum,and assembled specific energy in Wh/kg. Also report the actually attainable first discharge at masses selected by the incorrect reversible-only balance that omits eta,and whether that shortcut reaches the correct optimum.
scope: Conditional inventory/mass accounting only. Passive mass contributes to the denominator and no physical cell or safety recommendation is inferred.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled material/device reporting model;not an experimental assembly or performance claim.
